scope: synthetic contract-only audit; no candidate source, adapter, candidate output or receipt read or executed

finding.declared_policy: Only explicit status=opaque in a well-formed ledger yields Unknown; missing/malformed/inconsistent/incomplete evidence is Violated.
finding.measured_cause: check_features calls explicit_status before validating the remaining required context fields. ContractUnknown short-circuits classify, so malformed evidence can be hidden behind status=opaque.
finding.synthetic_mutation: Starting from oracle base(), delete feature_contexts[0].source and set feature_contexts[0].status=opaque.
finding.required_result: Violated because the ledger is malformed independently of its opacity declaration.
finding.impact: The classifier does not establish that Unknown is restricted to well-formed opaque fixtures. The existing four opaque controls keep all other fields valid and therefore do not discriminate this mutation. Seal is blocked.
